issue: कहुँ जागेस बेद जस गावै — जागेस is not a common word and no second witness was found (Drik Panchang only; web searches found no other site). It may stand for जोगेस (yogeśa, the lord of yogīs) or जगेस (jagadīśa).
our reading: कहुँ जागेस (as printed): somewhere as the lord, whose glory the Vedas sing.
alternatives: कहुँ जोगेस (somewhere the lord of yogīs); कहुँ जगेस (somewhere the lord of the world).

issue: कहुँ नृप कर कहुँ गाय चरावै: कर can be the verb (करै, makes) or the noun (tax, hand).
our reading: somewhere he makes kings, somewhere grazes cows (Kṛṣṇa set Ugrasena and Yudhiṣṭhira on their thrones).
alternatives: somewhere, as king, (takes) tribute; somewhere he is king.
